Name: Awesome Font
Author: itstern
Description:
This mod uses [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38900]Font Smasher[/url] to change the font style across most of the game, making it chunky and whimsical. All text is affected except for text that is produced as an image, rather than coded into the game (for example, the text on Pierre's shop sign will not be changed). This includes text in English, French, Spanish, German, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Turkish, and Hungarian, since it covers characters used in those languages.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/pLgTcMBt/compatibility.png[/img]﻿

This mod is compatible with most mods, including major expansions.

Compatibility for the following UI mods is included:

This mod will work with other UI mods but will use vanilla color for some text, which typically won't look great. Please ask me if there are other UI mods you'd like me to add color compatibility for.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/fLjYhfz5/troubleshooting.png[/img]

This font is a little difficult to read when using Lynnea's Recolor of Bog's Forest UI because of how the shadows are colored.

No other known issues, but please let me know if you run into any.
